issues.issue: the printed total includes the 32,000 transfers in, which are recorded in business_type.transfers_net. The extractor used a custom includes_split entry instead of includes: ["transfers_net"]. The validator handles both the same way, so the math ties (98,931.45 + 32,000 = 130,931.45), but the convention differs from the rules.

capital outlay rule wants 'Capital Outlay: <function>'; the General Fund column names no function, so the label was left as plain 'Capital Outlay'. disbursements[2] (31,070.52 = General 6,000 + Community Center 25,070.52) also keeps the plain label because it mixes two functions. This is a judgment call.
